newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler November vehicle production rises.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler November vehicle production rises.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said it produced 241,769 cars and trucks worldwide in November, up 2.3 percent from 236,252 a year ago.
So far this year, Chrysler has produced 2,673,999 units, a 17 percent increase over 2,285,267 for the first 11 months of 1995.
Chrysler produced 78,583 cars in November, up from 74,346 in November 1995. Total truck production for November was 163,186, a slight increase over 161,906.
Production from the U.S. and Canada accounted for 200,602 units, down from 203,608 in November 1995.
In Mexico, Chrysler's truck production grew to 20,039 from 15,107. Total car production from Mexico edged up to 11,843 from 11,616.
Chrysler also boosted production of its Grand Cherokee sport/utility and Voyager minivan in Austria to 9,285 from 5,921.
